consumer.use: Decide whether an atomic target-effect and transition-signature admission rule is semantically stable enough to justify any separately reviewed future admission-only shadow proposal.

decision_target.question: Can eight fixed adversarial target-effect cases be classified with zero material independent-review disagreement when the claim snapshot, subject, baseline, atomic effect predicate and transition path are frozen before classification?

intervention.name: atomic target-effect prospective admission boundary
intervention.description: Freeze a pre-intervention claim snapshot C, target subject S, contemporaneous baseline B, one independently falsifiable target-effect predicate E, the minimal ordered transition path T from B to E, and non-outcome delivery qualifiers Q. Treat earlier work as lineage-positive only when it already satisfied E, executed T on the same or evidence-supported equivalent subject, or the later identity is a result-informed residual/qualifier relabel. Treat pure baseline/input establishment as antecedent; fail closed when the frozen evidence cannot bind C/S/B/E/T or subject equivalence; a source-required effect property may not be demoted into Q.

control_condition.description: Exactly three frozen predecessor failure probes: S0-R2 create-versus-mutate ambiguity, residual/qualifier renaming escape, and the S0-R2 registration/procedure count mismatch. They are failure-context controls only, not invented paired cases.

treatment_condition.description: Apply the frozen S/B/E/T/Q decision procedure to exactly eight R3 treatment cases, including two eligible antecedent controls, four lineage-positive ineligible cases, one D0 not-applicable control and one subject-equivalence indeterminate case.

measurement.method: Freeze author classifications for exactly eight R3 treatment cases, then obtain an independent exact-head semantic review that restates C/S/B/E/T/Q, classifies all eight, attacks qualifier/baseline/subject renaming and verifies the exact unpaired 3-control/8-treatment procedure. Count any changed classification, required indeterminate downgrade, non-reproducible contract, credible renaming escape, blanket prior-mutation collapse, procedure mismatch or need for new production authority fields.
measurement.success: Zero material disagreements, zero credible renaming escapes, exact 3-control/8-treatment procedure coherence and zero authority effects. Success establishes paper-level semantic stability only and does not reopen P1 or start a natural cohort.
measurement.falsification: One or more material disagreements, non-reproducible C/S/B/E/T bindings, a viable qualifier/baseline/subject escape, blanket prior-mutation exclusion, any count/procedure mismatch, need for a new validator/control surface, or any productive authority effect rejects this revision for pilot use.

cost_metric.method: Measure independent semantic review handling time only. Any need for new production/control-plane fields remains a falsification condition, not a cost tradeoff.

comparability_constraints: control is exactly the three named predecessor falsification probes and is not treated as eight synthetic pairs
treatment is exactly the eight frozen R3 paper cases
author C/S/B/E/T/Q bindings and classifications are frozen before independent review
the independent reviewer classifies all eight treatment cases and reports the 3/8 procedure counts explicitly
no productive mutation is performed to generate a paper case
P1, S0 and S0-R2 verdicts are referenced and never rewritten
synthetic controls never count as natural-case evidence
confounders: paper facts are cleaner than natural task evidence
reviewer knowledge of prior S0 and S0-R2 rejection
atomic prose can still hide semantic granularity choices

allowed: merged rejected S0 and S0-R2 protocols and independent reviews
primary or contemporaneous GitHub/Bureau/runtime evidence already referenced by predecessor records
frozen synthetic case facts in the S0-R3 paper set

reviewed_exception.rationale: The explicit continuation authorizes only this bounded paper successor. It does not authorize P1 reopening, a natural cohort, validator, runtime integration or a new authority surface.
